uiReference.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Reference-only landscape pixel farm wardrobe screen. Input1 is existing actual wardrobe layout/style; input2 is sheep identity/pose reference. Preserve existing wooden cream panels, left large sheep preview, top-left stars balance plaque, top-right coin plaque, title above, right five cards and page arrows, bottom purchase/equip button. Show five small dressed sheep cards from strawberry red leaf cap, lemon cape, navy sailor, indigo stars and green postman concepts. Add subtle clear space just below balance plaques for usable-star and coin labels; small single currency icons with blank price area in cards; a short blank instruction line under cards distinguishing purchase/earned-threshold unlock. Keep face/style faithful, flat pixel outline, warm pasture, touch UI. No letters, Chinese, numbers or pseudo text anywhere. No extra large UI buttons. Actual words and prices will be rendered by game bitmap fonts. This is reference only, never a flattened runtime UI.

skins.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated pixel sheep SPRITE SHEET.
Input image: identity and fifteen-pose reference for the existing game's cream sheep. Preserve this exact small side-facing sheep identity: round fluffy oval wool body, small peach square muzzle, cocoa ears, tiny dark eyes, four short cocoa hooves, no horns. Flat two-dimensional coarse pixel art, warm outline and restricted colors, no 3D volume.
Composition: EXACTLY FIFTEEN full-body sprites in an EVEN 5-column by 3-row grid, left-to-right row-major, landscape 5:3 overall. Every equal-size cell contains exactly one complete sheep. Each sheep faces RIGHT. Same body dimensions and outfit in every cell; do not enlarge individual poses. Wide transparent gaps separating all cells and all rows, all hats/backpacks entirely within each cell with margin, no object crosses into an adjacent cell. No background, floor, shadow or glow. Genuine transparent alpha.
Pose ordering and actual pose differences:
TOP ROW: idle_1 (neutral standing); run_1 (front and back legs extended opposing, stride); run_2 (opposite diagonal contacts); run_3 (legs gather underneath torso, compressed step); run_4 (next extended opposite stride).
MIDDLE ROW: jump (legs clearly tucked airborne); fall (front feet reach downward landing); hit (recoil, squeezed eyes, lean back while facing right); dash_1 (strong forward lean with trailing legs); dead (lying on side horizontal, eyes closed).
BOTTOM ROW: idle_2 (gentle half blink/smile with same standing body); run_5 (push-off, front leg raised and back leg pushing); run_6 (passing phase, the other foreleg raised); dash_2 (second fast extended forward stride); dead_settled (distinct relaxed lying pose, head low and eyes closed).
Six run sprites must have SIX visibly different hoof/leg silhouettes forming a cycle, not cloned standing frames. Jump/hit/dead must be clearly distinguishable. Clothing/accessory sizes, color, attached position, and face must remain consistent in all fifteen poses including reclining poses; full props remain visible. No duplicate sprites.
NO text, Chinese, letters, numbers, frame labels, watermarks, dividers, grid lines or checkerboard. Art only.
Skin theme: cream white wool, strawberry-red small neck bow and a small green leaf cap with red strawberry ornament. Clearly visible unchanged peach face. Leaf cap and red theme accessory consistent in every pose.
